name: Merrin's Letter
summary: At the Whelgar's Excavation site, Merrin Rockweaver sends an urgent message from the Wetlands. Raptors have overrun the dig, but Merrin assures her loved ones that she survived.

sections.title: A Dispatch from the Ruins
sections.body: Merrin Rockweaver writes from the ruined dig at Whelgar's Excavation in the Wetlands. The dwarven expedition had been uncovering enormous prehistoric fossils and relics when they disturbed a nest of Mottled Raptors. The beasts swarmed the trenches, killed several workers, and cut off the surviving researchers. Amid the chaos, Merrin sends word to her husband Tarrel at Menethil Harbor. She, Prospector Whelgar, and Ormer Ironbraid survived behind a barricaded shelter.

faq.answer: Merrin Rockweaver wrote the letter while taking part in the archaeological expedition at the dig site east of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

faq.q: Who is the letter addressed to?
faq.answer: Merrin addressed the letter to Tarrel Rockweaver, who waits anxiously for news on the bridge at Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: What happened to the excavation team?
faq.answer: Mottled Raptors overran the archaeological team while it uncovered massive fossilized bones. Many dwarven workers were killed, and only a handful survived behind barricades in a makeshift camp.

faq.q: Who helped Merrin survive the attack?
faq.answer: Ormer Ironbraid helped Merrin survive the attack. He defended Merrin and the head prospector, giving them time to retreat to shelter while the raptors overwhelmed the rest of the dig.

angles.text: For a dwarf, Merrin's letter shows the personal cost the Explorers' League pays to uncover ancient history in the dangerous wilds of Khaz Modan.
For an Alliance traveler, delivering the note brings vital intelligence and bittersweet comfort to the sentries watching the Wetlands highway.
